battle.name: 九門之戰
battle.brief: 天寶十五載（756年）四月，郭子儀與李光弼在常山會師後，於九門城南擊敗史思明所部十餘萬之眾，李立節中箭身亡，燕軍退保趙郡、博陵。唐軍步卒以長槊列陣正面進攻，護送草料的五百輛車更組成披甲方陣行進，正是本卡斯巴達長矛所代表的密集長柄刺擊陣形在唐軍中的對應物。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 九門之戰發生在天寶十五載（756年）四月，交戰雙方是唐朝與大燕。唐朝一方由兩個節度使分統：河東節度使李光弼所部為先鋒，二月於常山擊敗史思明後乘勢收復常山郡治九縣中的七縣；朔方節度使郭子儀所部則自關中、河套一線東出，於四月初九抵達常山會師。合兵之後唐軍逾十餘萬人，另有裨將張奉璋率兵五百駐守石邑，專司糧草。燕軍一方是安祿山在洛陽建立的割據政權：本役發生時安祿山仍在洛陽稱帝，其子安慶緒以王爵與相職參預燕廷朝政，河北與幽州一帶的兵馬由大將史思明節制，其下有蔡希德、李立節等部將，並置偽趙郡太守郭獻璆。河北多數郡縣名義上仍奉唐正朔，史思明退保九門之後實際只控制部分城縣，燕軍的兵力和補給都遠不如其版圖表面龐大。就戰役性質而言，這既不是都城攻防，也不是單純的守城戰，而是兩軍在河北腹地由野戰會戰、追擊轉攻城的一連串作戰。
countriesEn: The Battle of Ji Men was fought in the fourth month of the fifteenth year of Tianbao (April 756) between the Tang dynasty and the rebel state of Yan. The Tang field army was split between two provincial commands. Li Guangbi, governor of Hedong, held the vanguard: in the second month he had defeated Shi Siming at Changshan and recovered seven of the nine counties of Changshan prefecture, most of which then declared for the Tang. Guo Ziyi, governor of Shuofang, marched east out of the Guanzhong and Hetao corridor and reached Changshan on the ninth day of the fourth month, where the two armies joined. The combined force numbered more than a hundred thousand men, and a detachment of five hundred under the subordinate general Zhang Fengzhang was stationed at Shiyi, responsible solely for fodder and supply. On the Yan side was the breakaway regime An Lushan had proclaimed at Luoyang. At the time of this battle An Lushan was still emperor there, his son An Qingxu held princely and ministerial rank in the Yan court, while the military command in Hebei and around Youzhou belonged to the great general Shi Siming, with Cai Xide and Li Lijie beneath him and a false prefect of Zhao prefecture, Guo Xuanxian, appointed in Zhao. Most Hebei counties still nominally obeyed the Tang calendar, and after falling back to Ji Men, Shi Siming in fact controlled only a handful of towns, so the Yan army was far weaker in men and supply than its map suggested. In kind this was neither a defence of a capital nor a simple siege: it was a sequence of operations in the belly of Hebei, moving from a field battle to pursuit and then to the assault of a walled city.
people: 唐軍方面，河東節度使李光弼是全役的先手與定樁人。李光弼出身契丹，父李楷含亦為唐朝將領，他於常山之戰中擊敗史思明，收復常山郡治所領九縣中的七縣，把河北的民心與地盤扭轉過來；隨後他退守常山、穩住東線，不急於與史思明決戰，並向郭子儀求援。朔方節度使郭子儀是會戰時的決定性力量，他率主力出井陘東進，四月初九抵達常山會師，使兩軍合兵逾十餘萬人，糧草亦隨之大盛，士氣為之一振。二人時人並稱「郭李」，在安史之亂的中期戰線上先後收拾史思明與安慶緒兩部，是唐軍反攻階段的兩根主柱。裨將張奉璋領兵五百守石邑，孤軍拒燕軍大將蔡希德，保障了唐軍的草料供應，是此役補給線上的樞紐。部將渾瑊在四月十一日九門城下交戰中射殺燕軍大將李立節，一擊而使叛軍失去指揮，扭轉戰局。燕軍方面，主持河北軍務的史思明是安祿山最倚重的宿將，出身幽州邊地，以騎兵奔襲與悍勇著稱，安祿山倚之為河北方面的柱石；大將蔡希德攻石邑受挫，率殘部退鉅鹿；大將李立節戰死於陣中；偽趙郡太守郭獻璆在趙郡城破時被殺。河北各縣的長吏與民眾亦參與其事，或反正歸唐，或自組武裝配合官軍，使唐軍得以在河北站穩腳跟。
peopleEn: On the Tang side, Li Guangbi, governor of Hedong, was the man who opened the campaign and planted the first stake. He was of Khitan descent, the son of the Tang general Li Kaihan, and in the fighting at Changshan he had broken Shi Siming and turned Hebei's loyalties and territory; he then held Changshan steady, refused to gamble everything on a pitched battle, and sent word to Guo Ziyi for help. Guo Ziyi, governor of Shuofang, was the decisive weight of the engagement: he led his main body east through the Jingxing pass and reached Changshan on the ninth day of the fourth month, joining forces with Li Guangbi and bringing the army to over a hundred thousand men with supplies to match, which lifted morale across the line. The two were known together as Guo and Li; over the middle years of the rebellion they successively wore down the armies of Shi Siming and An Qingxu and became the two pillars of the Tang counter-offensive. The subordinate general Zhang Fengzhang, with five hundred men at Shiyi, held off Cai Xide when the Yan general came to seize the supply depot, and so safeguarded the fodder that fed the horses and the marching column. The officer Hun Weng brought the turning point on the eleventh day: at the fighting south of Ji Men he shot the Yan commander Li Lijie dead, and the collapse of the rebel centre followed. On the Yan side Shi Siming was An Lushan's most trusted veteran, a frontier man from around Youzhou who had risen on the ferocity of his cavalry raids and whom his master relied on to hold Hebei; Cai Xide was repulsed at Shiyi and withdrew with the remnants to Julu; Li Lijie fell on the field; and the false prefect Guo Xuanxian was killed when Zhao fell. Hebei's local officers and communities played their part too, some declaring for the Tang, some raising armed bands of their own to work with the imperial army, and that is what let the Tang establish a firm footing in the province.
kits: 本卡兵器是斯巴達長矛，即希臘重裝步兵所用的兩米木槍，槍尾包銅，構思與成型都早於唐軍九百年，它並沒有出現在天寶十五載的唐軍序列之中。然而它在方陣裡的功能位置——成排的長柄刺擊兵器在重裝防護之後列陣前推、決定陣線的進退——在九門之戰裡有清楚的對應物：唐軍步卒手中的長槊與長槍、騎兵所用的馬槊，以及本役最著名的一段方陣護送。史思明派兵斷絕唐軍糧道，常山城中缺草，馬匹飼料不繼，李光弼派出五百輛車往石邑取草，駕車的人全部披上盔甲，又派弓箭手一千人護衛，組成方陣行進，才把草料運回常山。這個隊形正是本卡兵器所代表的那種盾牆式密集推進的翻版。唐軍在河北會戰中常見的裝備，還包括弓與弩、長刀與陌刀、各式盾牌，以及以皂色塗甲的精騎玄甲軍；燕軍則以范陽、幽州一系的騎兵為骨幹，早期叛軍曾大量繳獲唐軍與河北州縣的武備，配以雲梯、撞車等攻城器械，並大量使用騎兵游擊與斷糧襲擾。其餘值得一提的是本役的運輸能力：五百輛車往返石邑與常山，是一支偏重騎兵的軍隊在河北山地走廊裡維持行動的物資基礎。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the dory, the two-metre wooden spear of the Greek hoplite, its butt capped with bronze; the design is eight to nine centuries older than the Tang army of this battle, and no dory ever appears in a Tang roster. Its functional place in the phalanx nevertheless has an exact counterpart at Ji Men. The role of the dory was to give the massed line of long-hafted thrusting weapons that could break a charge before the swords were drawn, and at Ji Men that role was played by the Tang foot soldiers' long spears and langshao, the cavalry's cavalry spear, and above all by the square formation in which this battle is most famous. Shi Siming sent riders to cut the Tang supply road; grass fodder ran short inside Changshan and the horses had almost nothing to eat, so Li Guangbi sent five hundred carts to fetch fodder from Shiyi, the drivers all wearing their armour, with a thousand archers as escort, and the column moved as a square before it could bring the fodder back. That formation is the miniature version of the same idea the dory embodies. The rest of the Tang equipment in the Hebei operations consisted of bows and crossbows, long knives and the midao, shields of several patterns, and the elite mounted guard known as the Xuanjia, who were marked out by their black-lacquered armour. The Yan army was built on the cavalry of the Fan Yang and Youzhou districts, had taken large quantities of Tang and Hebei ordnance in the early years of the rebellion, used scaling ladders, battering rams and other siege gear, and relied on mounted harassment and deliberate cutting of supply lines. Transport deserves a mention of its own: five hundred carts shuttling between Shiyi and Changshan were the material base on which a cavalry-heavy army kept itself moving along the narrow corridors of the Hebei hills.
tactics: 九門之戰的戰術可以分成三段：先是小規模的據點爭奪與補給拉鋸，再是四月十一日九門城下的會戰，最後是直抵趙郡的追擊與攻城。拉鋸階段的核心是糧草。史思明占據常山、眼看河北各縣反正之後，轉而派游騎切斷唐軍糧道；常山城內缺草，馬無所食，李光弼不敢解城出戰，只能靠五百輛車、披甲的駕車者與一千名弓箭手組成方陣，往石邑方向取草。裨將張奉璋以五百人守石邑，在蔡希德率燕軍來攻時力戰不退，穩住了這唯一的草料來源。會戰階段，郭子儀於四月初九率軍出井陘抵達常山，與李光弼合兵十餘萬，糧草亦隨之大盛，兩軍士氣一振。史思明在兵力和補給都劣於唐軍的情況下，選擇在九門城南正面交鋒；唐軍以集中兵力的正面進攻對付燕軍，河北起義武裝在唐軍攻勢方向上作側翼牽制，燕軍大將李立節被射殺後，部眾失去指揮，一觸即潰。追擊階段，唐軍不給燕軍喘息：史思明退趙郡，再退博陵；四月十八日唐軍攻下趙郡，斬偽太守郭獻璆，繳獲兵器數萬件，並將繳獲的叛軍士卒四千人全數釋放，把士兵乘亂掠走的百姓財物一併歸還。軍紀上的這些處置，使河北各縣的抵抗意志迅速轉為支持官軍。
tacticsEn: The operation at Ji Men falls into three movements: a long struggle over a supply depot, a general engagement south of Ji Men, and a pursuit that ended in the assault of Zhao. The first movement turned on fodder. Having lost Changshan and seen the Hebei counties declare for the Tang, Shi Siming switched to raiding the Tang supply road. Grass was short inside the city, the horses were going hungry, and Li Guangbi dared not sortie; he could only send five hundred carts, with armoured drivers and a thousand archers drawn up into a square, to fetch fodder from Shiyi. Zhang Fengzhang held Shiyi with five hundred men and fought off Cai Xide when the Yan troops came for the depot, which protected the only source of fodder in the sector. In the second movement, Guo Ziyi came through Jingxing and reached Changshan on the ninth day of the fourth month; the combined host, more than a hundred thousand strong and now properly supplied, took the field with restored confidence. With men and provisions on the Tang side and the reverse on the Yan side, Shi Siming chose to accept battle south of Ji Men and fought head-on. The Tang concentrated their strength in a frontal attack while the Hebei volunteer bands engaged the rebels on the flank of the advance; when Li Lijie was shot down the Yan command lost its head and the formation broke. In the third movement the Tang gave the rebels no pause. Shi Siming fell back on Zhao, then on Boying; on the eighteenth day of the fourth month the Tang took Zhao, killed the false prefect Guo Xuanxian, captured tens of thousands of weapons, released the four thousand rebel soldiers taken prisoner, and returned the property that Tang soldiers had carried off in the disorder of the sack. Those acts of discipline converted the Hebei counties' resentment into active support for the imperial army.
data: 本役可核的數字都見於《資治通鑑》卷二百十七。時間線是：天寶十五載二月李光弼於常山擊敗史思明，常山郡所轄九縣中七縣反正；兩軍在九門一帶相持四十餘天；郭子儀於四月初九自井陘抵達常山會師；四月十一日九門城下大戰；四月十八日唐軍攻下趙郡。兵力方面，唐軍兩部會師後達十餘萬人，是安史之亂中規模最大的一次野戰集結；燕軍一方在常山與趙郡只剩史思明、蔡希德、李立節所部的殘兵，實力遠不如九縣反正前的盤面。糧草方面，石邑守軍五百人，護送草料的車輛五百輛，隨行弓箭手一千人，駕車者人人披甲。追擊階段，唐軍在趙郡繳獲兵器數萬，釋放被俘叛軍士卒四千人。此外河北民間自組武裝投奔官軍者，多者二萬人，少者萬人。戰役的縱深有限：常山至石邑、至趙郡、至博陵，都是沿太行山東麓與華北平原銜接的交通線，井陘是其中最關鍵的隘口之一，而燕軍正是靠卡住這條通道的補給段，讓唐軍在九門城下曠日持久。
dataEn: Every figure that can be checked comes from the Zizhi Tongjian, juan 217. The sequence of dates is: in the second month of the fifteenth year of Tianbao, Li Guangbi beat Shi Siming at Changshan and seven of the nine counties of Changshan prefecture came over to the Tang; the two armies then stood against each other around Ji Men for more than forty days; Guo Ziyi came through the Jingxing pass and reached Changshan on the ninth day of the fourth month; the battle south of Ji Men was fought on the eleventh; and the Tang took Zhao on the eighteenth. On strength, the two commands together mustered more than a hundred thousand men, remembered as one of the largest field concentrations of the whole rebellion, while the Yan side, at Changshan and Zhao, was reduced to the remnants of Shi Siming's, Cai Xide's and Li Lijie's units, far below what its territory before the defections had implied. On supply, the garrison at Shiyi was five hundred strong, the fodder convoy used five hundred carts, was escorted by a thousand archers, and every driver went out in armour. In the pursuit, the Tang recovered tens of thousands of weapons at Zhao and released four thousand rebel prisoners. Beyond that, popular bands in Hebei who threw in with the imperial army numbered as many as twenty thousand and as few as ten thousand. The depth of the operation was short: Changshan, Shiyi, Zhao and Boying all lie along the traffic lines where the eastern foot of the Taihang mountains meets the North China plain, with Jingxing one of the key gaps among them, and it was precisely by squeezing the supply stretch of that line that the Yan had held the Tang at Ji Men for so long.
cause: 九門之戰的直接起因是河北的拉鋸與唐軍的戰略選擇。安史之亂自天寶十四載（755年）安祿山在范陽起兵後全面爆發，叛軍很快攻陷洛陽與長安，玄宗奔蜀，肅宗即位於靈武，李唐在關中只剩收復兩京的目標。河北是安祿山的根據地，常山、真定一帶是其南北轉輸的樞紐，李光弼在常山取勝，等於在叛軍腹地插上一枚釘子，常山郡九縣中有七縣隨即反正。史思明退守九門，兩軍在常山周遭互相盯著：唐軍兵少、糧道受阻，河北人心未定；燕軍雖據城而勢衰，急於在援軍到來之前扭轉局面。於是史思明一面派兵斷糧、一面逼戰，李光弼則堅持不輕出，轉向郭子儀求援。深層的原因還有安史之亂中唐廷自身的反省：開元以來府兵制崩壞、府庫空虛、久安之兵缺乏實戰，朝廷在至德元載之後被迫倚重朔方與河東兩鎮的邊軍，而這兩支部隊的合流，正是本役得以以十餘萬人壓倒取勝的基礎。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the Battle of Ji Men was a stalemate in Hebei and a decision of Tang strategy. The An Lushan rebellion had broken out in full when An Lushan rose at Fan Yang in the fourteenth year of Tianbao (755); the rebels took Luoyang and Chang'an in quick succession, the emperor fled to Shu, and the Suzong was enthroned at Lingwu, leaving the Tang with a single objective, to retake the two capitals. Hebei was An Lushan's base, and Changshan and Zhending were the hinge of his north-south supply. Li Guangbi's victory at Changshan was a nail driven into the rebel rear, and seven of the nine counties of Changshan prefecture declared for the Tang there and then. Shi Siming withdrew to Ji Men, and there the two armies watched each other: the Tang were short of men and their supply road was being cut, the people of Hebei were undecided, and the Yan, though holding the city, were declining and wanted the position settled before reinforcements could arrive. So Shi Siming both raided for supplies and pressed for a decision, while Li Guangbi refused to be drawn out and turned to Guo Ziyi instead. Beneath that lay the reckoning the Tang court had been forced into since the first year of the rebellion: the collapse of the fubing militia system under the Kaiyuan peace, empty treasuries, and a long-peace army that had forgotten how to fight. From then on the court had to lean on the frontier commands of Shuofang and Hedong, and the junction of those two commands is the foundation on which the hundred thousand men who won at Ji Men were built.
impact: 九門之戰的影響，首先是河北局面的翻轉。史思明在常山、趙郡一線的據點被逐一拔除，他本人退守博陵，河北與山西之間的通道重新打開，使此後唐軍得以從河東、朔方向關中與河洛地區調動，同時也為不久之後的收復兩京之戰提供了前提。常山及周邊郡縣的反正，更令叛軍在河北的徵發與補給陷入困境：河北地方武裝大量湧向官軍，多的一次兩萬人，少的也有上萬，叛軍原本依賴的騎兵游擊與鄉村徵集，一時難以為繼。從戰術傳統看，此役留下兩個後續：一是唐軍在河北的攻勢由游擊拉鋸轉為據點攻堅與野戰會戰並行，二是軍紀成為爭取河北人心的手段——釋放被俘叛軍士卒、歸還士兵掠走的百姓財物，這些處置在史書中被反覆稱道，說明平叛戰爭的成敗並不只在戰場上。史思明本人退入幽州系統，叛軍的戰略重心由進攻轉為固守，兩京之戰的時間表因此被拉長，但南北對峙的大格局在燕軍失去河北之後已經不可逆轉。
impactEn: The first effect of Ji Men was the reversal of the situation in Hebei. Shi Siming's positions along the Changshan and Zhao line were picked off one by one, he himself withdrew to Boying, and the corridor linking Hebei with Shanxi was opened again, so that the Tang could thereafter move troops from Hedong and Shuofang toward Guanzhong and the Heluo region, and the reconquest of the two capitals that followed a few months later became possible. The defections around Changshan also broke the rebel machinery of recruitment and supply in the province: Hebei's armed bands flocked to the imperial side, twenty thousand men in one place and ten thousand in another, and the mounted harassment and village levies on which the rebels had relied could not be resumed at once. In terms of tactical tradition the battle left two legacies: in Hebei the Tang advance shifted from raiding and skirmishing to a combination of set-piece field battle and siege of fortified points, and discipline itself became a means of winning over the province's people, through releasing rebel prisoners and returning the goods their soldiers had looted, measures the historians praise again and again, showing that the war would be won as much off the battlefield as on it. With Shi Siming driven back into the Youzhou system, the rebel strategy turned from advance to holding ground, and the timetable for taking the two capitals was stretched out, but after the loss of Hebei the north-south balance could no longer be reversed in the rebels' favour.
result: 結果是唐軍完勝。史思明在九門城下的野戰中大敗，大將李立節被部將渾瑊射殺，蔡希德率殘部逃往鉅鹿，史思明本人退到趙郡，再退博陵郡固守。唐軍乘勝追擊直抵趙郡，四月十八日攻下城池，處死偽太守郭獻璆，繳獲兵器數萬件；郭子儀與李光弼把繳獲的叛軍士卒四千人全部釋放歸回，並將官軍士兵在攻城中乘亂搶走的百姓財物全部退還給原主。河北民眾見官軍紀律嚴明，紛紛響應起義武裝，支持官軍的隊伍達二萬人上下。戰役以史思明退守博陵、被唐軍包圍而告一段落：河北的戰略主動權自此轉入唐軍之手，安史之亂的攻守形勢在至德元載之後出現了第一次明確的反轉。不過燕軍主力尚存，兩京仍在叛軍控制之下，徹底平定尚需數年；史思明在博陵的固守與其後河北再度拉鋸，說明這場戰役只是唐軍反攻的一個節點，而非終局。
resultEn: The result was a Tang victory. Shi Siming was badly beaten in the field south of Ji Men, the Yan commander Li Lijie was shot dead by the officer Hun Weng, Cai Xide fled with the remnants to Julu, and Shi Siming himself withdrew to Zhao and then to Boying, where he shut himself in. The Tang pursued without pause, struck Zhao on the eighteenth day of the fourth month, executed the false prefect Guo Xuanxian and captured tens of thousands of weapons. Guo Ziyi and Li Guangbi released the four thousand rebel soldiers they had taken and returned to their owners all the property the Tang soldiers had seized in the disorder of the sack. Hebei's people, seeing the imperial army's strict discipline, came forward to help in numbers running to some twenty thousand. The campaign closed with Shi Siming shut up in Boying and besieged: the initiative in Hebei had passed to the Tang, and in the Zhide era the war's course turned decisively for the first time. The Yan main body was still intact, however, and the two capitals remained in rebel hands; full pacification took years more, and Shi Siming's stand at Boying and the renewed contest in Hebei that followed showed that Ji Men was a stage in the counter-offensive rather than the end of it.
